steps.instruction: Do not change how list() filters. The request is only to rename Todo.done to Todo.completed. My earlier acceptance test wrongly assumed that list() hides completed todos by default, and that was never part of this request. Keep the current behaviour that your existing tests pin down. Make sure every place that read or wrote `done` now uses `completed`. If that is already true, no source change is needed.

input.reason: Only my own acceptance test failed: it asserted a default filter in list() that the request never asked for. All other tests and tsc pass. Changing list() behaviour would go beyond a pure rename, so I'm replacing the acceptance test with one that checks only the rename.
